info.description: Core site identity plus the theme tokens most sites customize first

edit.label: Site Name
edit.description: Shown in the browser tab, the navbar brand, and anywhere the site name is read by assistive tech.

edit.label: Site URL
edit.description: The canonical address of the site — the base for absolute links. A wrong value breaks shared/social links.

edit.label: Locale
edit.description: Declared as the page language (<html lang>) and used for date formatting across the site.

edit.label: Logo
edit.description: Rendered in the navbar on every page. Empty shows the site name as text instead.

edit.label: Favicon
edit.description: Shown in the browser tab and bookmarks on every page.

edit.label: Primary color
edit.description: The site's main brand color — buttons, links and calls-to-action everywhere.

edit.label: Accent color
edit.description: Secondary highlight — badges and emphasis elements across the site.

edit.label: Text color
edit.description: The base text color used across every page.

edit.label: Background color
edit.description: The base background behind sections and cards site-wide.

edit.label: Corner roundness
edit.description: Default rounding applied to buttons, cards and inputs across the site.

edit.label: Tema avançado
edit.description: Fine-grained color and corner-radius overrides, for less common cases.
